name: Frigibax
description: Frigibax, the Ice Fin Pokémon. Able to evolve into Arctibax. A Dragon and Ice type.
pokedex_entries: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
